newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gold Peak sets US$40 mln two-tranche loan.
newsitem.headline: Gold Peak sets US$40 mln two-tranche loan.

text.p: Gold Peak Industries (Holdings) Ltd has launched a US$40 million revolving credit/term loan facility, lead arranger Commerz East Asia said on Wednesday.

Tranche A is a US$15 million revolving credit and Tranche B is a US$25 million term loan. Both tranches have a final maturity of four years and pay a margin of 65 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. The overall facility has an average life of 3.375 years.
Fees for both tranches are 62 basis points for co-lead managers committing US$4-5 million and 55 basis points for managers committing US$2-3 million.
Repayment of the revolving credit will be in bullet form while the loan will be repaid in five semi-annual instalments after two years' grace period.
Proceeds of the facility will be used for general working capital.
Commerz East Asia is the lead arranger and bookrunner.
Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Citicorp International, Banque Indosuez and Fuji Bank are the arrangers.
